summary: 71-year-old hiker missing since Aug 19 was found dead ~2.5 miles east of Blackhead Peak in the Lower Blanco drainage; his dog survived 2.5 months by his side; helicopter SAR recovery.
location: Lower Blanco drainage basin, ~2.5 mi east of Blackhead Peak, San Juan Mountains
responding_agency: Archuleta County Sheriff's Office; Taos Search and Rescue; helicopter flight crew
notes: Rich Moore, 71, of Pagosa Springs, reported missing evening of Aug 19 after a hike up 12,500-ft Blackhead Peak; ~2,000-hour search; found Oct 30 by a hunter; flown off mountain Oct 31; 14-year-old Jack Russell terrier Finney found alive and reunited with family.
